== Summary ==
Logo of the [[Players Committee]]: the current horizontal lockup of the STAR WARS Customizable Card Game mark beside the words PLAYERS COMMITTEE, the header logo shown on every page of starwarsccg.org, including its [https://www.starwarsccg.org/about-us/ About Us] page.
* '''Source:''' [https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/logo.jpg res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/logo.jpg] (390&times;121 JPEG). Downloaded from the live site on 10 October 2026; the identical file is in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125011445/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/logo.jpg Internet Archive capture of 25 January 2021]. An earlier transparent-PNG version of the same lockup is [[:File:PC logo horizontal lockup 2013.png]].
* '''Processing:''' none.
